normative_extracts.quote: The sendBeacon() method queues an asynchronous HTTP POST transmission that the user agent delivers in the background even after the originating document has unloaded.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The renderer hands the serialized payload to the browser network process with a 64 KB keepalive cap so the OS socket survives tab destruction.

production_failures.symptom: Analytics drops 35% of mobile session-end events when wired to the unload event
production_failures.root_cause: Mobile OSes suspend backgrounded tabs without firing unload, and unload/beforeunload listeners disable Back/Forward Cache (bfcache).
production_failures.mitigation: Flush telemetry on document.visibilitychange when document.visibilityState === 'hidden' and pagehide, never on unload.

production_failures.symptom: navigator.sendBeacon() returns false silently when flushing large error logs
production_failures.root_cause: Total pending keepalive + beacon bytes across the origin exceed the spec's 64 KB cap.
production_failures.mitigation: Batch telemetry below 64 KB, check the boolean return value of sendBeacon(), and fall back to IndexedDB retry on next load.
